summary: USACE-operated (Savannah District, Thurmond Lake; rec.gov phone 864-443-5441): fees 32/32 -> $28-32; booking confirmed recreation.gov with a 3-night holiday minimum and 14-in-30 limit; season seasonal (closed Sept 13, 2026 per Corps release; reopening date unpublished); 50 A + water; 34 sites to 45 ft, pull-throughs; bathhouses with showers, dump. Not affected by the Thurmond paving schedule (Hawe Creek not listed). Note left as is.
